body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Optoma presented its pocket-sized Pico projector 'PK-101' during CES 2009, which is smaller than most smart phones and weighs approximately four ounces.

The Optoma Pico PK-101 pocket projector can turn any environment into a mobile cinema experience and even connects to your iPod or other multimedia device. The PK-101 can be purchased for approximately $399.
